```{r setup environment, include = FALSE}

knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  message = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  echo = FALSE,
  include = TRUE
)

```

### 1 Data import

```{r set run}

data <- readxl::read_excel("datatable_LIP.xlsx", sheet = 1)
names <- data.frame( Name_orig = colnames(data)[16:ncol(data)])

path.output <- paste0(params$path.result, "07_Merge_multiple_tables/")

if (!dir.exists(path.output)) dir.create(path.output)

```

#### Standardize names
```{r standardize names, eval = params$run.pos}

final <-
  names %>%
  mutate( rep = str_extract(Name_orig, "^(?!-iso)+$"),
          left = str_extract(Name_orig, "^_iso") )
          
          left = str_split( Name_orig, "-iso")[[1]][1],
          iso = strsplit( left, "_iso")[[1]][2],
          left = strsplit( left, "_iso")[[1]][1])
```

#### NEG
```{r map features neg, eval = params$run.neg}

if ( grepl(".xlsx", params$path.datatable.neg) ){
  
  datatable.neg <-
    readxl::read_excel( params$path.datatable.neg)
  
  feature.neg <- 
    readxl::read_excel( params$path.datatable.neg, sheet = 2)
  
} else {
  
  datatable.neg <-
    read.csv( params$path.datatable.neg, 
              sep = params$datatable.sep,
              check.names = FALSE)
  
  feature.neg <- data.frame(Identity = "")
  
}


print("NEG datatable was imported from the following file:", quote = FALSE)
print(params$path.datatable.neg, quote = FALSE)

sample.neg <-
  params$sample.info.neg[match(datatable.neg$Sample.name, 
                               params$sample.info.neg$Sample.name), ] %>%
  arrange(Run.order)

datatable.neg <-
  datatable.neg[match(sample.neg$Sample.name,
                      datatable.neg$Sample.name), ]

rsd.neg <-
  calculate_add_rsd( data = datatable.neg[, -1], 
                     type = sample.neg$Sample.type)

feature.info.neg <-
  rsd.neg %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate( Identity_orig = Identity,
          Source = ifelse(grepl("w/o MS2", Identity), "public_db", 
                          ifelse(grepl("unknown", tolower(Identity)), "", "in_house")),
          Identity = strsplit( Identity, "-iso")[[1]][1]) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  left_join(params$lib[[params$method]]$pos, by = c("Identity" = "Library.name")) %>%
  mutate( Identity = gsub("w/o MS2:", "", Identity),
          Compound.name = ifelse( is.na(Compound.name),
                                  Identity,
                                  Compound.name),
          Identifier = paste0("neg_", Identity_orig),
          ) %>%
  left_join(feature.neg[, c(match("Identity", names(feature.neg)),
                            match("m_name", names(feature.neg)):ncol(feature.neg))], by = c("Identity_orig" = "Identity"))

data.neg <-
  cbind(sample.neg[, c("Sample.type", "Sample")], datatable.neg) %>%
  filter(Sample.type == "Sample") %>%
  select(-c(Sample.type, Sample.name))

colnames(data.neg)[2:ncol(data.neg)] <- paste0("neg_", colnames(data.neg)[2:ncol(data.neg)])

```

### 2 Merge data tables and map feature names
```{r merge}

if ( run.pos & run.neg){
  
  feature.info <-
    rbind(feature.info.pos,
          feature.info.neg)
  
  datatable <-
    data.pos %>%
    inner_join(data.neg, by = "Sample")
  
  if (nrow(datatable) == 0){
    
    datatable <-
      cbind(data.pos, data.neg[, -1])
    
    print("No matching samples were found, data from pos and neg were concatenated directly. Check if the sequence of samples in pos and neg are the same in input datatable.")
  }
  
  sample.info <-
    sample.pos[match(datatable$Sample, sample.pos$Sample), ] %>%
    select(-c("File.path", "File.name", "File.batch", "Sample.name")) 
  
} else if (run.pos){
  
  feature.info <- 
    feature.info.pos
  
  datatable <- datatable.pos
  
  sample.info <-
    sample.pos %>%
    select(-c("File.path", "File.name", "File.batch", "Sample.name")) 
  
} else if (run.neg){
  
  feature.info <-
    feature.info.neg
  
  datatable <- datatable.neg

  sample.info <-
    sample.neg %>%
    select(-c("File.path", "File.name", "File.batch", "Sample.name")) 
  
}

```

```{r remove feature}

feature.info.keep <-
  feature.info %>%
  mutate(Compound.name = trimws(Compound.name),
         m_name = make.names(Identity)) %>%
  group_by(Compound.name) %>%
  arrange(Compound.name, Source, desc(get(paste0("mean.", params$po.sample.to.use)))) %>%
  filter(row_number() == 1) %>%
  ungroup()

map.names <- feature.info.keep$Compound.name
names(map.names) <- feature.info.keep$Identifier

datatable.keep <-
  datatable[, colnames(datatable) %in% c("Sample", feature.info.keep$Identifier)]

colnames(datatable.keep)[-1] <- map.names[colnames(datatable.keep)[-1]]

print(paste0("For repeating features, the one with higher mean intensity in ", params$po.sample.to.use, " was kept."), quote = FALSE)
print(paste0(nrow(feature.info) - nrow(feature.info.keep), " features have been removed"), quote = FALSE)


```

### 3 Export
```{r export}

out.table <-
  sample.info %>%
  left_join(datatable.keep, by = "Sample") 

wb <- createWorkbook()
addWorksheet(wb, "datatable")
writeData(wb, "datatable", out.table)
addWorksheet(wb, "feature.info")
writeData(wb, "feature.info", feature.info.keep)
addWorksheet(wb, "feature.info.before.merge")
writeData(wb, "feature.info.before.merge", feature.info)
saveWorkbook(wb, paste0(path.output, "datatable_", params$method, ".xlsx"), overwrite = TRUE)

print(paste0("Datatable was saved as ", path.output, "datatable_", params$method, ".xlsx"), quote = FALSE)

write.xlsx( sample.info, file = paste0(params$path.result, "metadata.xlsx"))

print(paste0("Metadata was saved as ", params$path.result, "metadata.xlsx"), quote = FALSE)

```
